players.product: TGV (through-glass via) glass-core substrates for next-generation semiconductor packages (Kuki pilot line, customer evaluation; market mass production pushed to 2030)

quarterly_data.quarter: Dai Nippon Printing annual securities report: FY2026 (06-23-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Glass-core substrates, year ended March 2026 (annual securities report, management's analysis and R&D): to accelerate materials for next-generation semiconductor packages DNP set up a pilot line for TGV (through-glass via) glass-core substrates at Kuki Plant (Saitama), which began operating in December 2025, to verify mass production of glass-substrate technology combining fine wiring and high flatness; it began supplying customer samples in early 2026 (high-quality samples from January 2026) and aims at early commercialisation through joint evaluation with semiconductor makers, then a mass-production system.
quarterly_data.figure: TGV glass-core pilot line at Kuki Plant running since December 2025; high-quality customer samples since January 2026
